title: 香港旅游套餐
paragraphs: Now it is the best time for Hong Kong shopping lovers, as most shops are having their seasonal sales. With the same amount of money, people can buy more goods in the city. Women, young and old, can hardly resist the temptation (抵制诱惑) of this shopping paradise (乐园) at this time of year. Lovers will surely have an exciting Christmas and New Year’s Eve celebration at Times Square or in the western style bars. Spending your holiday in Hong Kong will be easy too, as several package tours are available from CZL Travel Service, with four-day tours for less than 15,000 yuan.

Tour Package 1 (3,200 yuan): a 4-day tour including three nights’ accommodation (住宿), helicopter flight, night ferry (游船) tour of Victoria Harbor and shuttle bus to the park to view the city at night.
Tour Package 2 (1,880 yuan): a 4-day-shopping tour including three nights’ accommodation, tour to Golden Beach and Vexork Museum, shuttle bus to the Peak and shopping malls.
Tour Package 3 (1,480 yuan): a 4-day-DIY tour including three nights’ accommodation in a four-star hotel and total freedom to do what you want and to go where you wish.

questions.reason: 选A：a travel service。首段明确介绍CZL Travel Service提供的package tours，后面是三种旅游套餐及价格，说明广告发布者是旅行社。广告虽提购物、住宿，却并非单个商场或酒店只推销自身服务。

questions.stem: According to the text, if you want to visit Victoria Harbor at night, you can choose Tour Package ____.
questions.reason: 选A：Tour Package 1。套餐1明确包含night ferry tour of Victoria Harbor，与题目“夜游维多利亚港”同时在地点和时间上对应。套餐2虽有景点和购物，但未列这项夜游；不能因都是四日游就混选。

questions.stem: If you are a shopping lover and you want to go to Golden Beach, you can choose Tour Package ____.
questions.reason: 选B：Tour Package 2。套餐2同时写明shopping tour和tour to Golden Beach，满足购物与去黄金海滩两个条件。只满足其中一个一般兴趣不够；套餐1、3没有明确列出这两项组合。

questions.stem: According to the text, if you want to plan your tour by yourself, you can choose Tour Package ____.
questions.reason: 选C：Tour Package 3。该项称为DIY tour，并承诺total freedom to do what you want and to go where you wish，对应自己规划行程。套餐1、2安排了具体游览项目，自由安排不是它们的主要卖点。

options: before Christmas and New Year’s Day
between Christmas and New Year’s Day
questions.reason: 选C：before Christmas and New Year's Day。广告说游客“will … have”圣诞和跨年庆祝，语境是在节日前招徕游客，非已经到节日当天。C是依据招徕未来假期的语气作出的推断；原文没有提供更精确的发布日期。
